blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings went from 134 to 120, and it took 11.1% of the city’s 351 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 137 to 132, and it took 6.6% of the city’s 591 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out East Newton for detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July (a buyers’ best bet).

items.t: East Newton homes and market figures

faq.a: SD36 schools in the area are Chimney Hill and M.B. Sanford elementary schools, and Tamanawis and Panorama Ridge secondary schools; the assigned school for a specific address is set through the SD36 School Locator.
The R1 RapidBus on King George Boulevard links Newton Exchange and King George Station via Surrey Central Station, and routes 321 and 324 run through the Newton street grid.

faq.q: Can an East Newton lot hold a duplex or more units?
faq.a: Yes, within the City's SSMUH framework — up to 3 units on lots under 280 m², 4 units on lots over 280 m², and 6 units on eligible lots of 281 m² or more within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; R3 and R5 zones also set duplex minimum lot areas of 557 m² and 225 m².

faq.q: Is East Newton in a floodplain or the ALR?
faq.a: No floodplain or ALR designation inside East Newton was confirmed on an official page; check a specific property's ALR status on the Agricultural Land Commission maps.
